scene_description: A smiling teacher stands at a chalkboard with math problems written on it, while several young students raise their hands eagerly to answer her question in a classroom.

questions.question: What do you think the teacher will do after she picks a student to answer?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine what happens next in the classroom.

questions.question: What do you think the teacher was doing right before the kids raised their hands?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine what happened just before this moment.

questions.question: Have you ever raised your hand in class or at school like these kids?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about your own time at school.

questions.question: What else could the teacher write on the board instead of math problems?
questions.evidence_hint: Imagine something different on the chalkboard.

questions.question: How do you think the kids feel when they raise their hands to answer?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about how you would feel if you really wanted to answer.
